sloka: वाताश्च कलुषा वान्ति कम्पते च वसुन्धरा ।पर्वताग्राणि वेपन्ते पतन्ति च महीरुःआः ॥६-२३-४॥।।
transliteration: vātāśca kaluṣā vānti kampate ca vasundharā ।parvatāgrāṇi vepante patanti ca mahīruḥāḥ ॥6-23-4॥।।

translations.english: "The wind is blowing mixed with dust, even the earth is cracking, mountain tops are shaking, and huge trees are breaking and falling down."
